text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the treatment.
Your nail designs are always
beautiful. However――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: To think you had an interest in work other than nail styling.

text_block_list.name: Nail Artist
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course it's fun, and I'm giving it my all!
It's just, I'd like to try challenging myself to a broader realm of "design."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oho... Then, may I make a proposal?
Regarding the new chance you are seeking.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: I'm scouting you—to be our academy's event designer!

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Designer
text_block_list.text:
The venue design for the fan appreciation event...!?
Um, I thought it was just going to be making posters and stuff at first...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I heard the production team was short on hands.
So I've been helping out with some of the tasks.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to accompany me to my meeting.
All you need to do is back me up if something comes up, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I came up with a draft for a centerpiece themed around "The Power of Racing" to decorate the venue...
but it still feels like it's missing something.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, there's no issue with the policy itself, but...
—What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Designer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me!?
Um, let me see~......

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Designer
text_block_list.text: Races truly are "powerful," aren't they? But why do you suppose they give off that impression... to you?

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps it's because there are so many powerful feelings at play.
After all, there are countless people who've lent their support, starting with the Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――Right. Indeed, they are by no means
fighting all on their own.

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Designer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Then, to show us joining forces...
maybe add more wings to the pillar, or include a design of holding hands――

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—! Yes, exactly this sense of "cooperation"!
What was missing was expressing the theme...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Rookie, wait!
Um, if you don't mind, please check the alternative proposal too――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Managing the production already, are you?
Everything seems to be proceeding smoothly, just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Apprentice Designer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's going miraculously well...
Casino-san, how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —I'm talking about your nails.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Setting the design aside, your communication skills were truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Gleaning a client's desires from conversation and bringing them to life.
That is precisely the quality required of a designer.
Which is exactly why――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I am certain of it.
This academy is the place where you truly shine.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Brand-new designs are always waiting.
――Designs worthy of your brilliance, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Casino Drive in high spirits
and decided to call out to her――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Planning for the event is progressing smoothly.
Plus, there were some delightful discoveries along the way.
choice_data_list: Ooh... As expected of a pro!
Ooh... As expected of a pro!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Planning for the event is progressing smoothly.
Plus, there were some delightful discoveries along the way.
choice_data_list: Ooh... As expected of a pro!
Ooh... As expected of a pro!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—No, a project is something we build together.
I could never succeed through my own efforts alone.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why we must guide them. In order to seize the dream as a team, you see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Actually, an acquaintance of mine joined the project.
And their talent blossomed in spectacular fashion.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has a place where they can truly shine.
...It brings me immense joy, truly.
